strings.drive.p.promise_to_be_there: Laka ete okozala kuna mpe mwa esika ekokangama mpo na bato nyonso. Elikya elakisami na elembo moko na moko; bileko ezali mibeko kino bobuki mbuma ya liboso eteya yango.

strings.ops.p.every_town_on_the: Engumba nyonso na karte ezali nzela euti na Kampala mpe ezali esika ya kotelema na yango moko. Esika application ya mboka esalaka, UG epesaka yango mobembo ya suka na esika ya komilakisa lokola nde ezali kuna.

strings.ops.p.each_plug_in_is: Eloko nyonso oyo babakisi ezali na esika na yango mpe clé na yango, ebombami na esaleli oyo kino okokota. Kangisa moko mpe ba buton oyo etali yango efungwami na Pool, Luka mpe Hustle Mode. Eloko moko te ebimaka na UG soki ofungoli te.
strings.ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on: Bato oyo tobundaka na bango bazali na liste na nko. Mobembi oyo andimeli bokokanisi azongaka mpo na pool mpe futela.
strings.ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace: UG ezali liboso zando. Ba application ya mibembo ezwaka ba réservation etondi mbongo ya koluka bakiliya te. Bisika ya kofutela mituka ezwaka bafuteli oyo batalisami. Ba hôtel ezwaka bituluku oyo ekoya na mokolo eyebani. Batambwisi bazwaka nzela etondi liboso ya kokende.
strings.ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates: Batambwisi mpe ba plaque bandimisami, buton ya lisalisi na mobembo oyo ekabolaka esika ozali na moto oponi, ba casque na boda nyonso oyo ekabolami, mpe reçu mpo na shilingi nyonso.

strings.ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool: Zomi na nkama na pool, ntalo moko ya kokoma mpo na kofutela, kofuta poso na poso na MoMo na nzela ya Flutterwave, mpe bakiliya oyo osengelaki koluka te.

strings.ops.p.deep_links_that_open: Ba lien oyo efungolaka application na yo na esika ya kobanda mpe ya kokoma etondi. Tolakisaka ata mokolo moko te ntalo oyo totangaki na polele te, mpe motindo ebimisami.

strings.ui.reviewNote: Mabongoli esalemi na UG mpe etalami mbala ya mibale; botali ya motangi ya mboka efungwami. Maloba oyo ezangi ezongaka na Lingelesi.

note: A full working Lingala translation of the interface in the Kinshasa register, plain and transactional. Carried for Congolese travellers on the Rwenzori and Bunia routes. Written by UG rather than by a first-language speaker; corrections are one tap away on every screen.
